Read `AGENTS.md` first.

Task: Replace ONLY the existing navbar center brand text/logo with the provided DINS by Daniyal image.

The logo already exists at:

`public/images/brand/dins-by-daniyal-logo.png`

### Requirements

* In the navbar center, replace the existing text-based `dINS by Daniyal` brand with the image logo.
* Use the existing image file exactly:
  `/images/brand/dins-by-daniyal-logo.png`
* Do NOT recreate the logo with text.
* Do NOT edit, recolor, crop, or modify the image file.
* Preserve the navbar's existing height, spacing, positioning, and overall layout.
* The logo must remain centered in exactly the same center-brand area.
* Make the image responsive so it looks correct on both desktop and mobile.
* Do NOT make the navbar taller.
* Do NOT change Search, Login, Bag, hamburger, or any other navbar functionality.
* Keep the existing mobile navbar structure unchanged except replacing the center text with the logo.
* Use proper `alt` text such as `dINS by Daniyal`.
* If the project uses Next.js Image, use the existing project convention and `next/image` appropriately.

### Important

Do NOT modify:

* Hero
* Shop By Category
* Product cards
* Products
* Colors
* Typography elsewhere
* Footer
* Database
* Supabase
* AI functionality
* Any unrelated component

Only make the navbar logo replacement.

### Verification

Run:

* `npm run lint`
* `npm run typecheck`
* `npm run build`

Verify:

* Logo loads correctly.
* Desktop navbar remains the same height.
* Mobile navbar remains the same height.
* Logo is centered.
* No layout shift or broken image.
* No unrelated files changed.

Database/Migration: **Not required — frontend-only navbar asset change.**

Do NOT commit, push to GitHub, or deploy to Vercel.
